text: Steenbarger: none of the clearing conditions is answered, so ADVANCE does not stand on my read. Mine is in_zone:ma_20 D. Elder buys the dip under a rising average (C10), not strength over yesterday's high: `elder` 10.0 is a plateau, summer (C20), and D 19.1% over the swing high is a chase. Weekly first (C21): I read `subcomponents.structure.wk_score` 15.0, not 5.0; the Chair must cite the served figure. I support the name, not this trigger. Clears on a pullback into the 20-day average with `elder` 7 or higher (not red, C3).
